text.en:
1. This order may be cited as the Federal Constitution (Modifica- Citation.
tion of Laws) (Ordinances and Proclamations) Order, 1958.

2. (1) The modifications specified in the fourth column of the Modifica-
Schedule to this Order, being modifications which appear to the Yang
di-Pertuan Agong to be necessary or expedient for the purpose of
bringing the provisions of existing law into accord with the provisions
of the Constitution, shall be made in the written laws specified opposite
thereto in the first and second columns of the said Schedule or, as the
case may be, in the provisions of the said laws specified in the third
column of the said Schedule and appropriate modifications shall be
poe in the marginal notes to the provisions specified in the third
column.

(2) Subsidiary legislation made under any of the written laws
modified by the said Schedule shall, in the absence of any specific
provisions in such Schedule, be read with such corresponding alterations
as to names or titles as may be necessary to bring such subsidiary
legislation into accord with the law under which it is made as so

modified.

3. The Yang di-Pertuan Agong may from time to time by order additions
add to the Schedule to this Order.                                      Schedule.
